system.description:
A special Dwarven make of the traditional crossbow. It can fire rocks or bolts. It counts as a crossbow but only requires 10 actions to load when firing bolts, or 6 actions when firing rocks. So well made it adds a +1D balance die to the wielder’s skill. Stats here are for bolts (crossbow range and damage); see Dwarven Arbalest (Rocks).

DoF modifiers: exceed obstacle +1, double obstacle +2, triple obstacle +3; extreme range -1 to the DoF.

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 125
